notes.title: The Cabin Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/76de03e06c20fbabbcceb53b8145c05011fb7e42.png[/img]
Hello everyone, today we are releasing our new update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/2d274fc40bc8696f655b8773624b2396c10b2d30.png[/img]
We have added a new web page inside the game and you can buy a new shop from here.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/939d98004b4666af53eced807a05e7c413b93b15.png[/img]
You can customize this shop you bought from the computer in it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/93d179aed6f119ae1b5a74fbe4a0e02f7b1db520.png[/img]
Here you can customize the content of the cabins you have purchased and recruit new employees.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/b4987a1c11464c0662fda63145148c23ae3ef052.png[/img]
Customers spend their time in the cabins as they wish and pay you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563180/Internet_Cafe_Simulator_2/

notes.title: New achievements and game settings
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/21a7cc39527c4535c52a4d28cba5b2f1dbab2189.png[/img]
Hello, you can change your current game settings while creating a new game or from within the game. You can turn off some features that adversely affect our game experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/9b54337b3cd6fc92c8592d04bd66d456e6857755.png[/img]
Added new achievements to the game. Achievement descriptions will be updated soon.
Made some minor bug fixes.
Minor fixes for in-game economy.

notes.title: The Hobo Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/76de03e06c20fbabbcceb53b8145c05011fb7e42.png[/img]
Hello everyone, Thank you very much for your support, here are the ones added with the first content update of Internet Cafe Simulator 2.
*The game now uses a new save system and so unfortunately the old game saves have been deleted.
**On some computers the old save system does not work properly. We created a new save system, but we could not integrate the old save system into it. We apologize to you all for this. We spent a lot of time on it, but we couldn't transfer it properly. In our tests, we saw that the new save system works very well.
Your save file is now here: AppData\LocalLow\Cheesecake Dev\Internet Cafe Simulator 2\save-data.save
Discord: https://discord.gg/Fue8XtE

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/ece7f193140311c935b62ff4a0467a2b0b808d42.png[/img]
A character has been added to the game that provides you with new quests.
A new website has been added to the game. You can purchase some enhancements from this website. Like illegal cafe commentary and police activity. Now the Police is coming to inspect the cafe.
A feature where you can automatically accept incoming requests has been added to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/920e8b8bd241683a6eb2a622ced01b79d7fc0fe1.png[/img]
If you want, you can add a different look to your cafe with leds.
Adjustments have been made to blackjack and other betting games. Some gambling games have been balanced.
Some sound effects have been reworked.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/a31ae45cd5bfe5bc8703577b4a2cb1dc86f0b4ed.png[/img]
Now you can buy an automatic spray that will automatically adjust the scent of your Internet cafe!
The bonuses provided by some abilities have been increased!
Now our character in the game has energy
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/7d814b69b4bd58f60f53143728c40ff835cadaa1.png[/img]
A web browser has been added to your computer in the game!
Now we can upgrade the our own computer in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/c2945f3febe33ca33875689bce74084b79730ac2.png[/img]
A new page has been added to the Skills tab, where you can increase the level of your ability such as hunger and energy.
If your character runs out of energy, he can pass out.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/fbf0b9f319fc9af14bcc0a2b81ad58cf8b935ff9.png[/img]
A cart selling hot dogs has been added to the city. You can satisfy your hunger here.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/8bcf4a99f35adf0e3178a40549ef81eb0690be3a.png[/img]
Now you can buy fire extinguishers that automatically extinguish the fires in the cafe!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/829614670e3e8a3f908bc2d92e0be28f5868e199.png[/img]
You can add new design to your home.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/926bed40135f5c747d00e79762e70f3b14aebb7b.png[/img]
Your partner has been added to the game. You can have children if you wish!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/378ba921beade837248b58e837cc73db301cd32c.png[/img]
A surprise weapon has been added to the game
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/0faa0cc24fa92de35982cb9e5f7af34a49d283ff.png[/img]
A cheat has been added to the game for the Warcry game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/9510fa14aee21fdf4f49609fdfec3c265252d774.png[/img]
You can now bet on horse racing in the game. One of the shops in the city organizes horse racing bets.
And a few innovations that we didn't include in the update notes, so as not to spoil the surprise.

-The thief can no longer evade the bouncer in any way.
-Fixed a bug that caused the character to get stuck in some areas.
-Mascot and some employees have been repositioned.
-Made some improvements to the cleaning robot. It no longer disappears out of nowhere and doesn't get stuck in corners.
-The bug of not being able to interact with NPCs while delivering CDs has been eliminated.
-Optimization work has been done on the animals on the map, various environmental models and some customers.
-Fixed a bug that caused us to get stuck inside the elevator.
-Fixed an animation bug that occurred while holding items.
-Fixed a bug that caused the player to get inside some walls inside the cafe.
-Fixed some problem areas in the Pathfinding system.
-Some models that negatively affect optimization have been reworked.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563180/Internet_Cafe_Simulator_2/

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/76de03e06c20fbabbcceb53b8145c05011fb7e42.png[/img]
-Fixed a bug in a mini-game in Kawaii.
-Alarm volume lowered
-Fixed collision issue with Camel prime.
-Fixed the issue of selling bags to the seller for a higher price.
-Fixed inventory locking issue when delivering food to customers.
-The position of the jug is now reset from the option menu.
-Fixed some translation errors.
-Miner revenues were rearranged. It's more profitable now.
-Crack operations are now easier.
-Fruit slot bonus game spin count has been reduced.
-Fixed a bug that prevents customers from entering the cafe in some cases.
-Warcry money bug fixed.
-I worked on some people's save file corruption issue. New saved will no longer be deleted.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947795/76de03e06c20fbabbcceb53b8145c05011fb7e42.png[/img]
-Slot machine bug fixed.
-Fixed a bug in the game Kawai.
-Fixed a resolution bug related to widescreens.
-Fixed a bug that occurred when purchasing an automatic door.
-Fixed a bug that occurred while delivering food to the customer.
-A model in the game has been replaced with a new one.
-Motion blur can now be turned off.
-The overall probability of computers getting burned has been reduced. Quality computers burn less than bad computers.
-Computers that are not connected to power no longer light up.
-The probability of occurrence of thieves and explosions has been reduced.
-Fruit slot uncommon bug fixed.
-Fixed an area on the map that caused instant fps drops.
